findings.summary: Closure retries do not define the already-CLOSED path after eligible grant collection.
findings.evidence: docs/issues/58/contracts.md:179-180 requires every CancelShip retry to invoke the reconciler for either terminal outcome; :188-194 defines that reconciler only for Committed/Cancelled/Closing, says lost replies repeat its read-back, and treats a missing COMPLETED grant as Internal. Yet :199-203 explicitly permits collecting grants once outgoing is CLOSED and only names EndDrSource as accepting that absence. A lost final closure reply followed by retry can therefore encounter CLOSED with collected grants and has no successful idempotent transition under these predicates.
findings.fix: Define an already-CLOSED fast path for ReportDrProgress(check_closure=true) and the reconciler used by CancelShip: return the unchanged durable outcome/all-closed mask without re-closing collected grants. Restrict missing-completed-grant=Internal to operations that have not durably established closure. Add lost final closure reply -> collection -> progress/cancel retry fixtures for both terminal outcomes.

findings.summary: The identical bind retry condition ambiguously requires COMPLETED on SENDING.
findings.evidence: docs/issues/58/contracts.md:162-164 says identical bind retry on Sending/Committed/Closing/Closed with COMPLETED outcome returns the stored record. Sending precedes foreign Begin/completion, so its normal outcome is still UNSPECIFIED; lifecycle.md:412-413 explicitly expects a lost bind response to return the same Sending record.
findings.fix: Separate the predicate: identical bound SENDING retries return the record with UNSPECIFIED outcome; completed Committed/Closing/Closed retries return their recorded completed outcome; cancelled outcomes refuse. Keep the lost-bind-response fixture aligned.
